description_en: Queries the digest of an image
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-image --image-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-instance-id cri-hfs6gaawhyu60000 --image-tag 1.8.0.15 --image-repo-id crr-7i88t7lx3fmf0000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
